examples.en: An accident happened suddenly, so I was in a daze.
I'm busy moving, so I don't even have time to eat.

examples.ko: 그 경황에 연락할 생각은 못 했어요.
examples.en: In that frantic moment, I couldn't think of getting in touch.

examples.ko: 정신없는 경황 중에 인사도 제대로 못 했어요.
examples.en: In all the confusion, I couldn't even say hello properly.

examples.ko: 경황없이 나오다 보니 지갑을 두고 왔어요.
examples.en: I rushed out in a hurry and left my wallet behind.

examples.ko: 지금 너무 경황이 없어서 나중에 전화할게요.
examples.en: I'm too overwhelmed right now, so I'll call you later.

explain: 거의 '경황이 없다', '~할 경황이 아니다'처럼 부정하는 말과 같이 써요. '정신이 없다'와 비슷하지만 '경황'은 무엇을 할 마음의 여유나 겨를이 없다는 느낌이 있어요.

phrases.en: I was so flustered that I couldn't even say hello.
phrases.nuance_ko: 마음의 여유가 없어서 어떤 일을 못 했다고 이유를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to give the reason you couldn't do something: no room to think.

phrases.en: This is no time to play.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞의 일을 할 만한 상황이나 마음이 아니라는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the situation or mood isn't right for doing the thing before it.
phrases.en_equiv: not in a state to do ~

phrases.en: I packed in a hurry and left the house.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes moving in a rush without any presence of mind.

explain_en: It is almost always used with negatives, like '경황이 없다' or '~할 경황이 아니다'. It is similar to '정신이 없다' but carries the feeling of having no mental room or leisure to do something.

examples.ko: 며칠 날밤을 새워서 오늘에야 작품을 끝냈어요.
examples.en: After staying up several nights, I finally finished the work today.

examples.ko: 날밤은 새웠지만 숙제는 아직 못 끝냈어요.
examples.en: I pulled an all-nighter, but I still haven't finished my homework.

examples.ko: 친구와 게임하다가 날밤을 새운 적이 있어요.
examples.en: I once stayed up all night playing games with a friend.
Staying up all night is not good for your health.
The baby was sick, so the parents stayed up all night.
I prepared this presentation even staying up all night, so I'm nervous.

explain: 거의 '날밤을 새우다'라는 표현으로만 써요. '밤을 새우다'와 비슷하지만 '날밤'은 한숨도 못 자고 지새운 밤이라는 느낌이 더 강해요.

phrases.en: I stayed up all night because of the exam.
phrases.nuance_en: 날밤 is almost always used in this expression.

phrases.en: I stayed up the whole night playing games without sleeping a wink.
phrases.nuance_ko: '꼴딱'을 붙이면 한숨도 못 잤다는 느낌이 더 강해져요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 꼴딱 strengthens the sense of not sleeping at all.
phrases.en_equiv: to stay up the whole night without sleeping

phrases.en: I talked with a friend and stayed up all night.
phrases.nuance_ko: '날밤을 새우다'보다 덜 강하고, 일상에서 더 흔하게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Less intense than 날밤을 새우다 and more common in daily speech.
phrases.en_equiv: to stay up the whole night

explain_en: It is used almost only in the expression '날밤을 새우다'. It is similar to '밤을 새우다', but '날밤' feels more like a night without any sleep at all.

en: to sit up all night; to stay up all night

examples.en: I stayed up all night yesterday because of the exam.
I stayed up all night playing games with my friends.
I pulled an all-nighter, so I'm very sleepy today.

examples.ko: 마감 전에는 팀원들이 다 같이 밤샘해요.
examples.en: Before a deadline, the whole team stays up all night together.
Staying up all night is bad for your health.

examples.ko: 연극 연습을 하느라 밤샘한 적이 많아요.
examples.en: I've stayed up all night many times rehearsing a play.

explain: 밤샘하다는 일이나 공부, 놀이 때문에 밤새도록 자지 않는 것이라 힘들다는 느낌이 있어요. 같은 뜻으로 '밤을 새우다'를 더 자주 말하고, '철야하다'는 뉴스나 공문서에 나오는 딱딱한 말이에요. 명사로 '밤샘 근무', '밤샘 작업'처럼도 써요.

phrases.en: I talked with a friend and stayed up all night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 뜻이고 일상 대화에서 '밤샘하다'보다 더 자주 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning, and more common in everyday speech than 밤샘하다.

phrases.example: 어제는 밤샘 근무를 해서 너무 피곤해요.
phrases.en: I worked all night yesterday, so I'm very tired.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밤새도록 하는 일을 말할 때 명사 앞에 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put before a noun to mean work done through the whole night.

phrases.en: I'm tired from staying up all night, so I'll sleep early.
phrases.nuance_en: The -아서/어서 ending links staying up to the resulting tiredness.
phrases.en_equiv: to be tired from staying up all night

explain_en: 밤샘하다 is staying up all night for work, study or fun, with a hint of hardship. 밤을 새우다 is the more common way to say it, and 철야하다 is a stiff word from news and official documents. It also works as a noun modifier, as in 밤샘 근무 and 밤샘 작업.

examples.en: I studied all night the day before the exam.

examples.ko: 회사에서 철야 근무를 하고 아침에 퇴근했어요.
examples.en: I worked an all-night shift at the company and left in the morning.

examples.ko: 철야 작업 때문에 눈이 너무 피곤해요.
examples.en: My eyes are so tired from the all-night work.
There was an all-night prayer meeting at church.
After staying up all night, I've been sleepy all day.

examples.ko: 축제 준비로 철야를 한 적이 있어요.
examples.en: I once stayed up all night preparing for a festival.

explain: '철야 근무', '철야 작업', '철야 기도'처럼 명사로 많이 써요. 말할 때는 '밤을 새우다', '밤새다'가 더 자연스러워요.

phrases.example: 어제 철야 근무를 해서 너무 피곤해요.
phrases.en: I worked an all-night shift yesterday, so I'm very tired.
phrases.nuance_ko: '철야'에 일 이름을 붙여 밤새 일하는 것을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say you work all night, by attaching the word for work after 철야.

phrases.example: 공사 때문에 밤마다 철야 작업을 하고 있어요.
phrases.en: Because of the construction, they're working through the night every night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공사나 공장처럼 밤새 이어지는 작업에 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits construction or factory work that continues all night.

phrases.en: I stayed up all night studying because of the exam.
phrases.nuance_ko: 말할 때는 '철야'보다 이 표현이 더 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: In speech, this sounds more natural than 철야.

explain_en: It is mostly used as a noun, as in '철야 근무', '철야 작업' and '철야 기도'. In speech, '밤을 새우다' or '밤새다' sounds more natural.

examples.en: I pulled an all-nighter last night because of the deadline.
The whole team worked through the night and finished the job.

examples.ko: 시험 전에 철야하면 다음 날 피곤해요.
examples.en: If you stay up all night before an exam, you're tired the next day.
I'll be working through the night again today.
We prepared a late meal for the staff working through the night.

examples.ko: 몸이 안 좋아서 철야하지 않기로 했어요.
examples.en: I'm not feeling well, so I decided not to stay up all night.

explain: '철야하다'는 잠을 안 자고 밤을 새우며 일하거나 공부한다는 말이에요. 일상 대화에서는 '밤을 새우다'를 더 많이 쓰고, 회사 일이나 기사에서는 '철야'를 써요. '철야 근무'처럼 명사로도 자주 써요.

phrases.en: At the hospital, I sometimes work an all-night shift.
phrases.nuance_ko: '철야'를 명사로 써서 밤새 하는 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses 철야 as a noun for work done through the night.

phrases.en: I stayed up all night studying the day before the exam.
phrases.nuance_ko: '철야하다'와 뜻이 같지만 일상 대화에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 철야하다 but more common in daily talk.

phrases.example: 건강이 중요하니까 너무 자주 철야하지 마세요.
phrases.en: Health is important, so please don't stay up all night too often.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with -지 마세요 to ask or advise someone not to do it.
phrases.en_equiv: please don't stay up all night

explain_en: '철야하다' means to go without sleep and work or study through the night. In daily talk '밤을 새우다' is more common, while '철야' appears in workplace and news contexts, often as a noun as in '철야 근무'.
